assessments.reasoning: The p.71 exact-type check admits the named scalar Long case. In the §5.3.1.11 runtime branches, a compatible ByRef argument classified as a value produces a local variable with the argument assigned. A compatible Long variable argument creates a reference binding to that variable.

challenge.method: Compare the exact type-compatibility guard at p.71 with both expression branches at p.72. Challenge with different declared scalar types, property/function results, Object and Variant branches, and imported library procedures on p.73.
challenge.results: A different declared scalar type would fail static compatibility. The value and variable branches both explicitly cover the applicable conditions. Object/Variant branches and library behavior have independent rules. No address, representation, or copying behavior follows.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
